text:
{
  "claims": [
    {
      "anchor": "Autovacuum relies on the statistics collection facility",
      "claim_text": "Autovacuum relies on the statistics collection facility.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states checks use statistics collection facility."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "if track_counts is off, autovacuum cannot be used",
      "claim_text": "If track_counts is off, autovacuum cannot be used.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Contrapositive of 'cannot be used unless track_counts is true'."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "turning track_counts on is by itself enough for autovacuum to work",
      "claim_text": "Turning track_counts on is by itself enough for autovacuum to work.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S2", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "'Only if' condition does not entail sufficiency."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Even when autovacuum is disabled, PostgreSQL still invokes it on tables that might contain unfrozen rows with XIDs older than autovacuum_freeze_max_age",
      "claim_text": "Even when autovacuum is disabled, PostgreSQL invokes autovacuum on tables that might contain unfrozen rows with XIDs older than autovacuum_freeze_max_age.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P0.S2", "rel": "entails"},
        {"sid": "P0.S3", "rel": "entails"}
      ],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P0.S2 states invocation; P0.S3 states even if disabled."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "The launcher tries to start one worker per database every autovacuum_naptime seconds",
      "claim_text": "The launcher attempts to start one worker within each database every autovacuum_naptime seconds.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P2.S2."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "with 4 databases and autovacuum_naptime set to 60 seconds, a new worker starts about every 15 seconds",
      "claim_text": "With 4 databases and autovacuum_naptime set to 60 seconds, a new worker starts about every 15 seconds.",
      "kind": "arith",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S3", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "60 / 4", "op": "==", "value": "15"},
      "reasoning": "P2.S3 gives interval as naptime/N."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Each database gets at most one worker at a time",
      "claim_text": "Each database gets at most one worker at a time.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": false,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S2", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P3.S2 says no limit on workers in a single database."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "running workers count against max_connections",
      "claim_text": "Running autovacuum workers count against max_connections.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S3", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P3.S3 says they do not count."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Autovacuum processes partitions like ordinary tables",
      "claim_text": "Autovacuum processes partitions like ordinary tables.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P5.S1."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "it does not run ANALYZE on partitioned tables",
      "claim_text": "Autovacuum does not run ANALYZE on partitioned tables.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P5.S2", "rel": "entails"},
        {"sid": "P8.S0", "rel": "entails"}
      ],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Both passages state this."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "it does not issue ANALYZE for foreign tables either",
      "claim_text": "Autovacuum does not issue ANALYZE commands for foreign tables.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P7.S0."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Normally a conflicting lock request interrupts autovacuum",
      "claim_text": "Normally a conflicting lock request interrupts autovacuum.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P6.S1 states lock acquisition interrupts autovacuum."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the same is true for an autovacuum that is running to prevent transaction ID wraparound",
      "claim_text": "A conflicting lock request interrupts an autovacuum that is running to prevent transaction ID wraparound.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S3", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P6.S3 states wraparound autovacuum is not automatically interrupted."
    }
  ]
}
